modules.title: Introduction to The Early Church
modules.html:
Pentecost, the work of the apostles, Paul's missionary journeys and the Council of Jerusalem. This section covers introduction to the early church.

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of the early church.
  • Be able to explain the early church in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Who was the couple that worked with Paul as tentmakers?
A: Aquila and Priscilla — Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Aquila and Priscilla.

Q: Moses was reluctant to lead the Israelites out of Egypt because he _____.
A: was a slow speaker — In Exodus 4:10, Moses complained to God that he was 'slow of speech and of tongue'.

examples.q: Who was the couple that worked with Paul as tentmakers?
Moses was reluctant to lead the Israelites out of Egypt because he _____.

quiz.q: Who was the couple that worked with Paul as tentmakers?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Aquila and Priscilla.

quiz.q: Moses was reluctant to lead the Israelites out of Egypt because he _____.
quiz.solution: In Exodus 4:10, Moses complained to God that he was 'slow of speech and of tongue'.

quiz.q: The Tenth Plague that finally broke Pharaoh's heart was the _____.
quiz.solution: The death of every first-born in Egypt, including Pharaoh's son, forced the King to release the Israelites.

quiz.q: The Ten Commandments were given to Moses on Mount _____.
quiz.solution: Exodus 19-20 records the giving of the Decalogue (Ten Commandments) on Mount Sinai.

quiz.q: The wall of Jerusalem was rebuilt after the exile under the leadership of _____.
quiz.solution: Nehemiah was the cupbearer who returned to Jerusalem specifically to lead the reconstruction of the walls.

quiz.q: The parable of the Good Samaritan was told to explain the meaning of _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus told it in response to a lawyer's question: 'And who is my neighbor?'

quiz.q: At the Last Supper, the wine symbolized Jesus' _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus stated that the cup represented His blood, which was to be shed for the remission of sins.

quiz.q: The Holy Spirit descended on the disciples on the day of _____.
quiz.solution: Acts 2 describes the arrival of the Holy Spirit on the Day of Pentecost, 50 days after Easter.

quiz.q: The Jerusalem Council was held primarily to discuss _____.
quiz.solution: Acts 15 records the debate over whether Gentile converts needed to be circumcised and follow the Law of Moses.

quiz.q: The specific sin of Ananias and Sapphira was _____.
quiz.solution: They kept back part of the proceeds of a land sale while pretending to give the full amount to the church.

quiz.q: Hagar was the handmaid of _____.
quiz.solution: Sarah gave her Egyptian maid Hagar to Abraham to bear a child on her behalf.

quiz.q: The 'Man of Sorrows' is a Messianic title found in the book of _____.
quiz.solution: Isaiah 53 contains the 'Suffering Servant' prophecy, describing the Messiah as a man of sorrows.

quiz.q: Which of the following women was a judge in Israel?
quiz.solution: Deborah was a prophetess and the only female judge mentioned in the Book of Judges who led Israel to victory over Jabin's army.

quiz.q: During the temptation, the devil asked Jesus to turn stones into bread to test His _____.
quiz.solution: The temptation 'If you are the Son of God...' was an attempt to make Jesus use His divine power for selfish physical needs.

quiz.q: At the Last Supper, the bread represents Jesus’ _____.
quiz.solution: Jesus took bread, blessed it, and said, 'Take, eat; this is my body' (Matthew 26:26).

quiz.q: Saul's conversion took place on the road to _____.
quiz.solution: Saul was traveling to Damascus to arrest Christians when he was blinded by a light and heard the voice of Jesus.

quiz.q: Samson's strength was tied to his vow as a _____.
quiz.solution: As a Nazirite, Samson was consecrated to God from birth, and one of his conditions was never to cut his hair.

quiz.q: Ten Commandments given at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Sinai.

quiz.q: First Martyr:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Stephen.

quiz.q: Deborah was a:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Judge.

quiz.q: Ahab's wife:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Jezebel.

quiz.q: Moses saw the burning bush at Mount:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Sinai/Horeb.

quiz.q: Gideon defeated the Midianites with:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 300 men.

quiz.q: Who was the female judge in Israel?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Deborah.

quiz.q: The name 'Moses' means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Drawn out of water.

quiz.q: The 'Beatitudes' are found in the Gospel of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Matthew.

quiz.q: The wife of Ahab was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Jezebel.

quiz.q: The significance of the Passover in Israel was to commemorate...
options: The crossing of the Red Sea
The giving of the Ten Commandments
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Their deliverance from Egyptian bondage.

quiz.q: Jesus' first miracle was the...
options: Turning water into wine at Cana
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Turning water into wine at Cana.

quiz.q: The centurion at the cross remarked, 'Truly this man was the ___'.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Son of God.

quiz.q: The Golden Rule is:
options: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you.

quiz.q: Absalom rebelled against his father:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: David.

quiz.q: The Temptations of Jesus focused on:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Food, Power, Pride.

quiz.q: Dorcas was known for:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Good works/Charity.

quiz.q: Proverbs was written mainly by:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Solomon.

quiz.q: Holy Spirit at:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Pentecost.

quiz.q: Psalms writer:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: David.

quiz.q: Man was created in the image of God to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Have dominion.

quiz.q: Moses was hidden for three months by his parents because?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: He was a fine child.

quiz.q: The first city captured by Joshua in Canaan was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Jericho.

quiz.q: Saul was rejected by God because he?
options: Disobeyed by keeping the spoil of Amalek
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Disobeyed by keeping the spoil of Amalek.

quiz.q: Daniel was thrown into the lions' den because he?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Prayed to God.

quiz.q: The "Suffering Servant" passage is found in?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Isaiah.

quiz.q: Who was the husband of Esther?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Ahasuerus.

quiz.q: What did Zechariah see in his vision of the lampstand?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Two olive trees.

quiz.q: Jesus fed 5,000 people with?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 5 loaves and 2 fishes.

quiz.q: Judas betrayed Jesus for?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 30 pieces of silver.

quiz.q: The "Lost Sheep" parable shows?
options: God's joy over one sinner who repents
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: God's joy over one sinner who repents.

quiz.q: Saul’s conversion happened on the road to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Damascus.

quiz.q: John wrote Revelation while on the island of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Patmos.
